text: エサの　タマタマを　つかんで　１００キロさきの　す　まで　はこぶ。

structure.jp: エサの　タマタマを　つかんで
structure.en: it grabs its prey, Exeggcute, and

structure.jp: １００キロさきの　す　まで　はこぶ。
structure.en: carries it to its nest 100 km away

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb (here ending in んで) joins one action to the next, like 'and'. つかんで = 'grabs it and'.
